summary_1line: Dhritarashtra fears the combined might of the Pandavas and Krishna, recounts their powerful allies, and sends Sanjaya to seek peace with Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot with the Gandiva drawn, arrows pouring forth like a storm cloud covering the sky.
Krishna strikes down Shishupala, who falls like a great tree uprooted by a violent gale as shocked kings scatter.
Krishna and Arjuna sit together upon the same chariot, a sight that makes Dhritarashtra tremble for the fate of the Kuru race.
